column1: # composer-drift-versions.tsv - the single machine-readable record of which
# harness release tests/fm-composer-drift-live-e2e.test.sh last ran against
# and passed. bin/fm-bootstrap.sh's composer_drift_version_check reads this
# file every session and reports a COMPOSER_DRIFT_UNVERIFIED diagnostic for
# any installed adapter whose current `--version` no longer matches its row
# (or has no row at all), so a harness upgrade is flagged instead of forgotten
# Update a row BY HAND, immediately after
# passes for that harness - never edit a row without having just run the
# guard. One owner: do not record these versions anywhere else.
